title: How Did a Walk-On Offer Become $156 Million?
description:
His dream college offered him only a walk-on spot. Guess what happened?

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Stephen Curry: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stephen_Curry
- Wikipedia: Forbes list of the world's highest-paid athletes: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbes_list_of_the_world%27s_highest-paid_athletes

From Wikipedia (Stephen Curry): Virginia Tech offered him only a walk-on spot, partly due to his 160-pound frame, so he chose Davidson; in July 2017 he signed a five-year, $201 million extension, the first NBA supermax over $200 million; in March 2025 he became the first player with 4,000 career three-pointers. Forbes (Wikipedia: highest-paid athletes): 2025, $156 million ($56M salary, $100M endorsements); 2026, $124.7 million. Not financial advice.

cta: Curry or LeBron? Comment your pick.

scenes.narration: His dream college offered him only a walk-on spot. Guess what happened?
Too skinny, they thought. About 160 pounds. So he went to Davidson instead.
Then he signed the first NBA deal over 200 million dollars.
Then came 4,000 career threes. The first player ever.
But the real money? In 2025, sponsors paid him 100 million dollars.
